t: Writing Trino(Presto) Queries
s: Treasure Data uses two query engines that use SQL commands as well as a pre-defined query interface that allows the user to filter data using company-defined attribute and behavior filters. All of this can be found in the TD Console. The two query engines are Trino and Hive and the query editor for those are found in the Data Workbench under Queries.
